items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Yeah, I was playing with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played, he played, he played on records, on some of the records. Oh yeah? Yeah. With what band? With the Big Collins and them. Oh. Yeah, Joe Strutter. Yeah, Joe Strutter. He was a good drummer, too, boy. What happened to him? He died, too, huh? No, he run away. I didn't know what happened to him. Oh yeah? It wasn't so long, boy. I didn't know what happened to him.

I think there's some Strutter still in town. We could probably find his family. I mean, I think he must have some family here, because that name, I see it all over town, Strutter. Yeah, Strutter, it might. Yeah, we might catch up. Do you have something? Yeah, yeah, I wanted to ask you, what did David Jones play like? Was he any good?

Yeah, I was playing with him. Oh yeah? He played saxophone, he played everything. Mm-hmm. He played everything, boy. That's the only man I know could play a lot of French in one, boy. I'm in a place. I'm in a pool. I'm in a place. Mm-hmm. Professor Jones.
